subject: general
question: Select the correct pair from the following options.

options.text: Object's resistance to change its state of motion - Gravitation
Object's resistance to change its state of motion - Inertia
Object's resistance to change its state of motion - Momentum
Object's resistance to change its state of motion - Acceleration

solution:
The correct answer is __**Object's resistance to change its state of motion - Inertia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Inertia** is the property of an object that resists changes to its state of motion.
 
• An object at rest will stay at rest, and an object in motion will stay in motion with the same speed and direction unless acted upon by an unbalanced force.
 
• Inertia is directly related to the mass of an object; the greater the mass, the greater the inertia.
 
• It is a fundamental concept in Newton's First Law of Motion, which is also known as the Law of Inertia.
 
• Inertia explains why passengers in a moving vehicle feel a jolt when the vehicle suddenly stops or starts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gravitation**

 
 
• Gravitation is the force by which objects with mass attract one another.
 
• It is responsible for the falling of objects towards the Earth and the orbits of planets around the sun.
 
 
 
• **Momentum**
 
 
• Momentum is the product of an object's mass and its velocity.
 
• It is a vector quantity, meaning it has both magnitude and direction.
 
 
 
• **Acceleration**
 
 
• Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity of an object with respect to time.
 
• It is a vector quantity and can result from changes in speed, direction, or both.
